text: It moves! It has soggy eyes though. So soggy.
You! Soggy! Your friends ran off. The bear ate one. His guts are sogging up ahead.
The other one took your stuff. He went towards the festering man.
The festering man knows. Find him.
Another! The sea spat you out too, huh?
Your language is foreign to me. Do you speak the common tongue?
Aye. My flesh was unwelcome even in her hungry gullet, thanks be.
[narrate]He shakes his head and points to the library upstairs.[/narrate]
I’m afraid my cookpot is also empty. But if you find 3 cuts of goblin flesh you’ll feed us both! [narrate]He holds up 3 fingers[/narrate]
And I am always willing to trade if you have brought anything of value.
Welcome to my most unpleasant home.
